scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build
